Forum Discuss about new features, ask questions, share best practices, etc. Comparisons vs Plus Sign (+) Trick vs Firefox Relay vs Apple's Hide My Email Pricing Login Sign Up Receive and send emails anonymously With email aliases , you can be anonymous online and protect your inbox against spams and phishing. Open source . Based in Switzerland. Get your aliases for free >> 1,000,000+ happy users Recommended by How does Email Alias work? Shield your inbox with email aliases. 1. Use Email Alias everywhere Next time a website asks for your email address, give an alias instead of your real email. 2. Receive emails safely in your inbox. Emails sent to an alias are instantly forwarded to your inbox without the sender knowing anything. 3. Send emails anonymously Just hit "Reply" if you want to reply to a forwarded email: the reply is sent from your alias and your real email stays hidden. You can also easily send emails from your alias. Create and manage your aliases everywhere Quickly create an alias on the go. Sign up for a newsletter, create a new online account with a click. Email aliasing loved by users Once I used it, it was a game changer. SimpleLogin is in my book criminally underrated. Techlore Privacy for the masses SimpleLogin seems to me ahead of the game. It's all open-source and I mean everything, the apps, the service, the website. Michael Bazzell IntelTechniques I like to use SimpleLogin for trowaway accounts like restaurant reservations or newsletters. I opt for SimpleLogin because it allows me easily to shut off an address. SimpleLogin is a very effective SPAM control measure. Naomi Brockwell Tech Journalist I personaly use SimpleLogin as my email aliasing tool. SimpleLogin login is an important part of my strategy. Josh All Things Secured I usually have to enter my email while subscribing to new services online, albeit without much confidence. SimpleLogin gives me a trustworthy alternative and helps me controlling my privacy on the Internet. Nguyen Nhat Cuong Senior Software Engineer at Facebook SimpleLogin gives me the convenience of a social login button with the privacy of an anonymous email address.
